title: No Body Steering Bike of the California Superbike School
summary: California Superbike School demonstrates its 'No B.S.' bike, which has fixed handlebars so riders can only steer with body lean. It illustrates how little control that gives compared with countersteering.
why: HN recommends it as an eye-opening demonstration of why countersteering matters on two wheels.

quote.text: It is really eye opening on how little control you have without countersteering.
